frontmatter.title: The Importance of npm in Front-End Development
frontmatter.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Managing JavaScript Dependencies
frontmatter.excerpt: Unlock the full potential of front-end development with npm (Node Package Manager). Dive into npm's features like package management, sharing packages, easy version management, and its powerful command-line interface. This comprehensive guide includes real-world use-cases and code examples to make you an npm pro.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
